**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Clear Capital:

- **§ 1(a) (p0004)** engages RadialSpark only "on a task by task basis" under separately negotiated Statements of Work — no minimum volume, requirements commitment, or preferred/sole-provider designation.
- No language matching the detection triggers ("sole and exclusive provider," "all of its requirements," "shall not procure … from any third party") appears anywhere in the document; searches for *exclusive*, *sole*, *compete*, and *third party* returned only unrelated provisions.
- The two "exclusive" hits are benign: **p0020** confirms Contractor retains ownership of its pre-existing proprietary materials, and **p0051** is the standard entire-agreement clause. Neither restricts our sourcing.
- **§ 13 (p0047)** is a mutual employee non-solicitation covering hiring, not purchasing, and applies reciprocally to both parties.

This satisfies the preferred playbook position (no exclusivity binding Customer), so no edit was needed.
